pages.text: The $(d)Obsidian Skull$() has a chance of negating fire damage while in your inventory.$(br2)The more damage that would have been taken, the higher the chance of negation. The exact formula is:
`` (damage ^ 3) / 100 ``$(br2)The $(d)Obsidian Skull Ring$() does the exact same, but can be worn in a Curio slot.
